name: Escritorio con patas abiertas y dos cajones
adaptations: splayed legs with side stretchers drawn as tapered legs under an apron, with no stretchers; the pedestal side keeps its panel
two drawers, one at each end of the top box, drawn as a two-drawer pedestal on the left; the open niche in the middle is not drawn
750 high by 1500 wide by 550 deep, read from the photos (the seller did not say the order)
notes: En Knotty queda como un escritorio de 150 × 55 cm con patas cónicas y faldón de un lado y, del otro, una cajonera de dos cajones. El original lleva un cajón en cada extremo, un nicho abierto al centro y las patas abiertas con travesaños.
